P.field_metadata: Static role definitions accompany one-candidate source-only fidelity requests. Relevance separately sees original question/source/faithful candidates; no generated task description or keyword decisions.
P.split_filter: Each candidate fidelity has its own independent tensor row and no question/other candidate fields, except event predicate for binding. Only faithful units enter question relevance. Both raw stages saved in filter_stage_audit.json. No automatic subject restoration.
P.new_verbatim_check: Probe actors/predicates must occur in source (case-insensitive); catches hashes/underscores/name omissions. Runtime conversion does not repair these.
